plugin.name: Clipboard Catgirl
plugin.description: Watches your clipboard and pokes you proactively: recognizes what you copied and offers translation, explanation or a nudge; anything that looks like a password, key or token is never read or stored. Rate-limited (poll interval, cooldown, hourly cap), privacy-first, and one switch to keep her quiet.
panel.title: Clipboard Catgirl - Panel
panel.subtitle: Watches the clipboard and speaks up; never looks at passwords or keys
panel.privacy_desc: Anything that looks like a password, key or token is never read or stored; only content hashes are kept for dedupe; everything is processed locally.
